Original owner-supplied Ellipse Engine from ellipse-engine-complete.zip (archive SHA-256 b7e190c5035271675e25bca4ee43bbc3dea024e92a2555a649ee688b5089bcc7). Original arrangement is CC0; the supplied program adapts CrispStrobe BSD-3-Clause controls. The owner requests CrispStrobe / BSD-3-Clause for these application adaptations. Raw source and its CC0 grant remain here. All 169 authored placements are preserved. Archive validators and reports are references, not qualification of the current app; tests rerun the real parser, VM and physics with an independent output observer.
